questions.q: The chapter says pushmi-pullyus "are now extinct." What does "extinct" mean?
choices: There aren't any more of them
They live only in zoos now
They have learned to hide very well
They have moved to another country
questions.evidence: That means, there aren't any more.

questions.q: What did a pushmi-pullyu look like?
choices: It had two tails and one very large head with long ears
It had no tail, but a head at each end with sharp horns
It had a long neck like a giraffe and four horns on its head
It looked like a small horse with a single horn in the middle
questions.evidence: They had no tail, but a head at each end

questions.q: Why could no one ever sneak up on a pushmi-pullyu?
choices: It could hear footsteps from many miles away in the jungle
It always hid in the very tallest grass by the edge of the river
Whichever way you came, it faced you, and one head always stayed awake
It ran faster than any other animal in all the jungles of Africa
questions.evidence: only one half of him slept at a time

questions.q: How did the monkeys finally catch up with the pushmi-pullyu?
choices: They chased it into the river until it got much too tired to swim
They joined hands and made a great circle round the high grass
They dug a deep hole and covered it with leaves and grass
They called to it in a friendly voice until it came out
questions.evidence: they all joined hands and made a great circle round the high grass

questions.q: Why did the pushmi-pullyu not want to go at first?
choices: He was afraid of the long sea voyage
He was shy and hated being stared at
He did not want to leave his family behind
He did not trust any man at all

questions.q: How long did the monkeys try to persuade the pushmi-pullyu?
choices: One whole night
Two weeks
Three days
A month
questions.evidence: for three days they tried to persuade him

questions.q: Why did Dab-Dab say the Doctor should take the pushmi-pullyu home?
choices: She thought it would be good company for Jip and Gub-Gub on the ship
People would pay to see him, so they could buy the sailor's boat and live
She wanted the pushmi-pullyu to help her with all the housework
She was afraid the King's soldiers would catch it if it stayed behind
questions.evidence: how are you going to get the sailor the new boat you spoke of

questions.q: What did the pushmi-pullyu make the Doctor promise before he agreed to go?
choices: To feed him fresh grass and honey every single day
To never put him in a cage or a menagerie
To send him back if he did not like it there
To bring his mother along with him on the ship
questions.evidence: if I do not like it in the Land of the White Men you will send me back

questions.q: Why does the pushmi-pullyu keep one mouth mostly for eating?
choices: So that it never gets hungry while it is walking through the jungle
So it can talk while eating without being rude
So that one head can guard the food from other animals
Because the other mouth cannot talk any language at all
questions.evidence: In that way I can talk while I am eating without being rude.

questions.q: What advice did the Doctor give the animals in his speech at the party?
choices: Always wash in the river before going to bed at night
Never trust the King of the Jolliginki or any of his soldiers in the jungle
Keep flies off your food, and do not sleep on the ground in the rains
Keep away from the ships of men who come to hunt
questions.evidence: never to let the flies settle on your food before you eat it

questions.q: What did the Grand Gorilla do to mark the place where the Doctor ate with them?
choices: He carved the Doctor's name into the trunk of a great tree
He rolled a great rock up to the head of the table
He planted a tall palm-tree right where the Doctor had sat
He built a little house of grass on the spot where they ate
questions.evidence: rolled a great rock up to the head of the table

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How the Doctor gave a long speech after eating many fruits
How the monkeys found the rare pushmi-pullyu and he agreed to go with the Doctor
How the pushmi-pullyu told the Doctor all about his family and the last of the Unicorns
How the monkeys walked with the Doctor to the edge of their country
questions.evidence: And Chee-Chee very proudly took the animal inside and showed him to the Doctor.
